subject: Deployment topology assertion & onboarding playbook — Dedicated/Private
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@veridian.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: topology assertion & onboarding checklist for Dedicated/Private

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Veridian's security and procurement teams are preparing our SIG and SOC 2 intake. Before we proceed with the formal questionnaire, could you provide a concise 'topology assertion' packet that covers the Dedicated and Private deployment models? Specifically we need:

- A one-page network topology figure that highlights control-plane vs data-plane boundaries for both Dedicated and Private installs.
- A short narrative explaining tenant isolation controls and routing/egress constraints.
- A checklist for our onboarding team that lists artifacts we'll need (logs, KMS attestations, network ACLs).

We are aiming to complete the pre-screen this week. A PDF and a short checklist would be ideal. If anything needs to be redacted for IP reasons, please note that in the document.

Regards,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Security Program Manager — Veridian Financial

---
Veridian prefers attachments as zip bundles; please include file names in the email body so our intake system can index them.
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@veridian.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 19:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: topology assertion & onboarding checklist for Dedicated/Private

Alicia —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attaching an initial packet: redwood_topology_v1.pdf (diagram + narrative) and a short control checklist (redwood_control_matrix.csv). I've also compiled a minimal evidence bundle with sample logs and interface lists (network_evidence_bundle.zip) — that contains sanitized samples and references (no production secrets).

Quick clarifying notes:
- The enclosed topology is intentionally high-level: it marks control-plane endpoints, model-serving pools, tenant-overlay boundaries, and egress choke points.
- For Private (VPC/on-prem) installs we list KMS integration options (customer-managed or Redwood-managed) and where HSM attestations live.
- We call out the optional air-gapped deployment pattern in an appendix; let us know if you want a separate diagram for that.

Action items we propose on our side (for your intake):
1) You confirm whether you need full port-level rules or the high-level CIDR/ACL map.
2) If required, we can produce a redacted port/ACL spreadsheet (sensitive ports replaced with category labels).
3) If SOC 2 requires 90-day logs vs 365-day logs, we will swap the sample logs in the evidence bundle.

Kimberly and Marcus — looping you in to confirm the diagram labels and to approve the evidence bundle for redaction.

Best,
Priyom
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_topology_v1.pdf (diagram + narrative), redwood_control_matrix.csv, network_evidence_bundle.zip
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@veridian.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 01:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: topology assertion & onboarding checklist for Dedicated/Private

Priyom / Alicia —

Reviewed the packet quickly and left three inline comments in the PDF (see page footers) related to:
- Labeling of the control-plane ingress (we should call it 'control API cluster' vs 'control plane') to avoid confusion with customer control-plane proxies.
- An explicit note on fallback routing: we list model-variant fallback as 'automatic' but need to call out the policy boundary (customer opt-in vs Redwood-managed).
- KMS section: add a pointer to the KMS attestation process doc (internal) and flag if Veridian wants an on-site HSM validation.

Marcus — can you confirm we are comfortable shipping the sanitized log samples, and whether we should replace the 365-day retention example with a 90-day sample for initial intake?

Alicia — one more operational note for your intake team: for Dedicated installs we include a short runbook that describes a staged tenant onboarding (API keys → network ACL verification → smoke test with synthetic requests). If you'd like that as a separate one-pager we can attach.

Kimberly Park
Principal Security Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@veridian.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: topology assertion & onboarding checklist for Dedicated/Private

Alicia —

Thanks for the patience. Attached are the updated artifacts: redwood_topology_v1.pdf (with clarified labels and the fallback policy callout), redwood_control_matrix.csv (added KMS attestation steps), and network_evidence_bundle.zip (sanitized; retention examples set to 90 days per Kimberly's suggestion).

For your intake system: bundle filenames and short descriptions are listed below so your automation can index them.
- redwood_topology_v1.pdf — single-page annotated diagram; appendix covers air-gapped pattern; redactions noted inline.
- redwood_control_matrix.csv — checklist mapping controls to evidence files and owner.
- network_evidence_bundle.zip — contains sample logs, interface lists, and anonymized ACLs.

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleTopologyLink
HubSpot intake record: https://hubspot.redwood.com/records/VER-7892

If Veridian needs a signed assertion (PDF with signature block) for the SIG intake, we can prepare a one-page signed topology assertion and route it via DocuSign. Let us know and we'll attach the signed PDF.

Regards,
Priyom

Attachments: redwood_topology_v1.pdf, redwood_control_matrix.csv, network_evidence_bundle.zip
